scope: Public transport contract only; no upload, token, private-account access or inference

model.basis: Existing 1005m model schema/source evidence; not rerun

upload.contentType: multipart/form-data; boundary generated by FormData or explicit multipart encoder
upload.filename: UTF-8 <=255 bytes in file part; no full local path
upload.inputURL: response.urls.get copied verbatim after origin/id validation; official JS util and Python helpers pass this to prediction input

limit.openapi413Detail: Files must be less than 100MB in size

expires.note: Do not hardcode sample TTL or apply prediction retention to all uploaded Files resources

identityCheck: id on poll equals persisted id
data_removed must not be true before unarchived recovery
prediction.cancel: POST /v1/predictions/{id}/cancel, success200 prediction object, then inspect/poll terminal state
prediction.deadline: Cancel-After minimum5s; lifetime from creation; timeout of HTTP request alone does not cancel remote prediction
prediction.credentialOrigin: https://api.replicate.com only; authenticated request redirects rejected
prediction.unknownPOST: No automatic retry after network/parse/persistence ambiguous result; no idempotency guarantee identified in public contract

rateLimits.retryPolicy: Bounded GET/backoff permissible; never repeat charge-bearing create on ambiguous 5xx/network failure

retention.predictionDefault: input parameters/output values/output files/logs removed after1h; archive each successful branch immediately
retention.recovery: data_removed or expired/missing remote outputs with incomplete local archive -> recovery failure, no automatic inference

filesPost.description:
Create a file by uploading its content and optional metadata.

Example cURL request:

```console
curl -X POST https://api.replicate.com/v1/files \
  -H "Authorization: Token $REPLICATE_API_TOKEN" \
  -H 'Content-Type: multipart/form-data' \
  -F 'content=@/path/to/archive.zip;type=application/zip;filename=example.zip' \
  -F 'metadata={"customer_reference_id": 123};type=application/json'
```

The request must include:
- `content`: The file content (required)
- `type`: The content / MIME type for the file (defaults to `application/octet-stream`)
- `filename`: The filename (required, ≤ 255 bytes, valid UTF-8)
- `metadata`: User-provided metadata associated with the file (defaults to `{}`, must be valid JSON)

metadata.description: User-provided metadata associated with the file

type.description: The content / MIME type for the file

detail.example: Files must be less than 100MB in size

checksums.description: A dictionary of checksums for the file keyed by the algorithm name

content_type.description: The content / MIME type of the file

id.description: A unique, randomly-generated identifier for the file resource

metadata.description: Metadata provided by user when the file was created

size.description: The length of the file in bytes

urls.description: A dictionary of URLs associated with the file resource

get.description: A URL to the file resource

completed_at.description: The time that the model completed the prediction and all outputs were uploaded

created_at.description: The time that the prediction was created

data_removed.description: Whether the prediction output has been deleted

deadline.description: The absolute time at which the prediction will be automatically canceled if it has not completed

deployment.description: The name of the deployment that created the prediction

error.description: An error string if the model status is `"failed"`

logs.description: The log output from the model

metrics.description: Additional metrics associated with the prediction

total_time.description: The total time, in seconds, that the prediction took to complete

model.description: The name of the model that created the prediction

output.description: The prediction output, which can be any JSON-serializable value, depending on the model

source.description: Indicates how the prediction was created

started_at.description: The time that the model began the prediction

status.description: The prediction status. `canceled` means the prediction was canceled (either by the user or because it reached its deadline while running). `aborted` means the prediction was terminated before it started running (for example, when a deadline is reached before the prediction starts).

urls.description: URLs for working with the prediction

get.description: Retrieve the latest state of the prediction via API

stream.description: An event source to stream the output of the prediction via API

web.description: View the prediction in a browser

oneOf.description: The ID of the model version that created the prediction
The model does not support versions, used by official models.
